payload.blocks: Nothing; repo hygiene only. Plan is closed on board (ebbfcdc9d).
payload.headline: Delete the leftover branches of done plan 261122-2108 (14 merged, 7 with commits not on main)?

parts.cause: The supervisor runs confined and .git is read-only for it, so 'git branch -d' is refused (Read-only file system); the lead's own worktree remove was refused ref-invalid.

options.does: Run: git branch -d delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p01 delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p02r delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p03 delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p04s delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p04t delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p05t delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p06 delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p07t delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p08 delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p09 delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p10 delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p10b delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p10r delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p11
options.gain: Clears 14 branches with zero data loss (-d refuses anything unmerged).
options.label: Delete merged only

options.cost: One command; irreversible except via reflog.
options.does: The command above, plus: git branch -D delete-dead-node-execution-closure/{p02,p04,p04r,p05,p05r,p07,p07r}
options.harm: Discards 7 branches' unique commits for good, unless they are truly superseded.
options.label: Delete all 21

parts.recommendation: Delete merged only: safe by construction; inspect the 7 unmerged before any -D.

scope.allows: Deleting branches named delete-dead-node-execution-closure/* in the main clone.
scope.forbids: Touching any other branch, worktree or main itself.

parts.what: Plan 261122-2108 is done and its phase-10 worktree is removed. 21 branches delete-dead-node-execution-closure/* remain: 14 merged into main, 7 (p02, p04, p04r, p05, p05r, p07, p07r) carry 1-4 commits not on main, most likely superseded attempts replaced by the r/t variants.
